# Shraddha Mishra

> Machine-learning systems researcher building reproducible infrastructure, experimental frameworks, and dependable technical systems.

My work has progressed steadily from building AI models to building dependable systems around them, and from one field to the next. I have repeatedly taken on roles in fields where I had no prior background, including quantum machine learning, receipt recognition, production NLP backends and cryptographic side-channel analysis, and delivered working, documented results in each.

I intend to investigate autonomous, risk-aware decision-making among adaptive and adversarial agents under regime shift, and to engineer systems that remain reliable on difficult, assumption-violating data. Financial markets are my intended testbed, because they demand robustness, adaptive reasoning, and disciplined execution under risk.
